posts.author: NickTheBrick
posts.body:
I am currently making fun little rpg where you need to fill out a bestiary, much like the hunters journal in Hollow Knight. What I like about the hunters journal is how when you kill a certain number of a specific enemy, you get an extra description of that enemy.
The plugin I am using is the CGMV Encyclopedia, version 1.8
I know that the encyclopedia plugin allows you to add a description of an enemy once you defeat it once. What I want to know is if it is possible that I can show an extra description after the player defeats a certain number of a specific enemy, much like the hunters journal, and if so, how would I go about doing it?

posts.author: JamesRyan
posts.body: I used to ask for help like this, but people are also busy with their own projects or work, so it's quite hard to find someone to do this, especially when it involves editing others' plugins. For some simple QoL improvement, I think you can try to get some help from the AI. Just provide it with enough information, and it should be fine. That's what I have been doing.

posts.author: rpgLord69
JamesRyan
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
If you do it like the above poster suggested, many of the users here will s*** on your game.
Click to expand...
People do hate the use of AI, and I know it
But when you don't have a choice, that's a good way to consider. Just make sure not to rely on it too much. I have been using it only to correct grammar and do some simple QoL improvements if needed, which are hardly known from the player's perspective and usually harmless (but I still state clearly what is supported by AI). I don't recommend using AI for most of the things that heavily affect your game and your creativity, such as art, music, script, lore, etc. AI should be a supporter to us, not something that should replace our work.
